title: Transparent images no longer get a navy background
detail: Image blocks (like the EUPD award badge) now show transparent PNGs correctly on the page background — the dark placeholder colour only appears in empty image slots.

title: CMS editor: type freely again
detail: Editing text in the page-builder no longer loses focus after each keystroke — you can type normally, and saves are batched instead of firing on every key.

title: Report a bug or request a feature from the CMS
detail: You can now raise issues and ideas straight from the admin. They land in a queue we work through, and every fix or new feature gets logged here.

title: The CMS goes live
detail: The page-builder now saves to the database and publishes real pages to the website, with an admin login and approval flow for the team.

title: Enquiries dashboard
detail: Every quote-form submission is captured and shown in the admin with lead statuses, alongside an email alert.

title: New site foundation
detail: New marketing pages, the shared mega-menu header, brand fonts and the free-quote form wired to email.
